units.text: 1. Concealment, deliberate distortion or untimely communication of complete and accurate information on the state of the environment and natural resources, on sources of pollution of the environment and natural resources or other harmful impacts on them, on the radiation situation, of data obtained in the course of industrial environmental control, or of information contained in an application for state registration of facilities having a negative environmental impact, an environmental impact declaration, a declaration of payment for negative environmental impact, a report on the implementation of an environmental protection action plan or an environmental efficiency improvement programme, as well as distortion of information on the condition of land, water bodies and other environmental objects by persons obliged to communicate such information under the legislation of the Russian Federation, except in the cases provided for by Parts 13 and 14 of Article 8.2, Articles 8.5.2 and 8.5.3, Parts 3 and 4 of Article 8.50 and Article 8.51 of this Code —
